x: ..........From the "Club Circular" October 1908: "The opening boxing show will be held in the large hall at Headquarters on the third Tuesday in October and all members should turn up as Mr.Lambert has arranged some very interesting contests.

Startling early season sprint form came from Dwain Chambers with young Chris Lambert also causing a few eyes to open. Pride of place must go to Phillips Idowu though - his 16.41 triple jump extended his Club Record by a further 6 cms. - and Mike Jones, who also set a new Belgrave best in the hammer.
Jon Lambert looks back at the McDonalds YA series for 1999 The season began, as it was to continue, trying to get a team together seemed almost impossible.
